claims.goal: Make every rtxForge package use the same comprehensive, actionable functional testing across Windows and Linux, with real runtime evidence, per-component results and fixes, and editable bug-report prefills.
claims.acceptance: (1) Before launch: package files present and rtxForge-managed, sane saved settings, overlay helper running, panel shortcut set, and on Linux a Proton build with CUDA. (2) While playing: sample the in-game panel's live snapshot about once a second through companion_controls: nr_running, nr_ms, NR placement, rendered fps, native presented/generated frames and MFG mode, fg_successes, Dynamic MFG support, failure text and stalls. (3) At Finish: collect the route's logs, including Feeder (ReShade, dlss5-feed) and Vulkan (fgvk), and record a result per part with its evidence: hook loaded; NR model created, running, GPU time and placement; MFG achieved multiplier vs. requested; panel connected; helper running and attached. (4) Each result that isn't 'working' gets a likely fix from known failure patterns, for example: MFG set but no generated frames (enable frame generation in the game); NR created but no GPU time (NR disabled or intensity 0); no snapshot (bridge not loaded or a hook conflict); Proton without CUDA. (5) It suggests Working or Problem (the user decides), and its summary pre-fills Bug Report's NR and MFG answers and details. (6) Visual correctness is never claimed.
